svg.title: ApexAi access layers: ApexAPI, ApexMCP, and product plugins
svg.desc: ApexAPI (HTTP · software): Typed HTTP for applications that submit jobs, send messages, work support conversations, and read results and history. ApexMCP (MCP · agents): Tools and resources that let agents discover, inspect, retrieve, and take named actions inside a product. Product plugins (operators · control): Keep a deployment healthy, verified, and correctable, with approvals and evidence for every step. Each product ships its own contracts; there is no shared gateway across products.
